columns.content: Purify us Lord from the deviousness: of the leaven of the Sadducees: for we understood Your wonders: and believed in Your Lordship.
For blessed is the Father and the Son:  and the Holy Spirit:  the perfect Trinity:  we worship Him and glorify Him.
Through the prayers of the Preacher of the Ninevites, Jonah the Prophet; O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
Hiten nieu,y `nte pirefhiwis `nte niremNineu`y Iwnac pi`provytyc@ P[oic `ari`hmot nan `mpi,w `ebol `nte nennobi.
Our Lord Jesus Christ, Create within us for you, a temple of Your Holy Spirit, so as to glorify You.
Blessed be the Father and the Son / and the Holy Spirit / the perfect Trinity / we worship Him and glorify Him.
